svg.desc: MC = two-bit index preview; HR = one-bit preview. Runtime changes are labelled explicitly.
svg.text: Other game graphics: bombs, scenery, jigsaw, radar and death effect
MC = two-bit index preview; HR = one-bit preview. Runtime changes are labelled explicitly.
Scenery / MC: initial bank (ANIMAT replaces 198-200 at runtime)
Animated brick samples / MC: first frame of BRIK3, BRIK1 and BRIK2
Explosion: ANIEXP rewrites glyph 248 ($3FC0) from $8000,X; its live texture is not a fixed asset.
Text, score lettering, borders and interface symbols are catalogued in the full character atlases.
